headline: EdgeConneX, a data center company, and Stockland, an Australian property group, have formed a joint venture to build large data center campuses in Sydney and Melbourne.
score_reason: Concrete deal but no price or timeline in the source.
importance_line: Australian grid users and local communities may see large new power demand in Sydney and Melbourne, the two companies share the risk, and no cost or build dates are given.
summary: Telecompaper reports that EdgeConneX, a data center operator, has entered Australia through a 50-50 joint venture with property group Stockland to develop, own and operate large data center campuses, starting in Sydney and Melbourne. The venture says it has 450 megawatts of power secured and is seeking more.
notes: Source is short and has no financial terms.
